import json, subprocess, sys

def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

# model predicts class 0 always (dense bias favors 0); fallback is 1
doc = {
 "version": 1,
 "config": {"slots": 1, "window": 1, "idle_timeout": 5, "len_quantum": 1,
            "gap_quantum": 1, "rate_num": 1000000, "rate_den": 1,
            "bucket_capacity": 512, "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512,
            "lanes": 1, "service": [1, 1], "fallback": 1, "time_edges": [0],
            "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]},
 "model": {"classes": 2, "embedding_dim": 1,
           "length_embedding": [[5] for _ in range(16)],
           "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
           "kernel": 1, "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]]], "conv_bias": [0],
           "conv_shift": [0], "dense_weights": [[1], [0]],
           "dense_bias": [100, 0]},
 "connections": [{"id": "x", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
 "packets": [{"time": 0, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
             {"time": 1, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
             {"time": 2, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
             {"time": 8, "connection": "x", "length": 0, "draw": 0}]}
o = run(doc)
print("forwards:", [p["forward"] for p in o["packets"]])
print("gens    :", [p["generation"] for p in o["packets"]])
print("preds   :", [j["prediction"] for j in o["jobs"]])
print("votes   :", o["connections"][0]["votes"], "pred", o["connections"][0]["prediction"])
# expectations: pkt0 forward=1 (fallback), job0 pred 0 applied at t=1 -> pkt1 forward 0,
# pkt2 forward 0; t=8 gap 6 >= 5 -> reset -> pkt3 forward 1 (fallback again), gen 2
assert [p["forward"] for p in o["packets"]] == [1, 0, 0, 1], "forward"
assert [p["generation"] for p in o["packets"]] == [1, 1, 1, 2], "generation"
assert o["connections"][0]["votes"] == [2, 2]
print("OK")
PYEOF
